title: Sanctions/PEP list entry
description: One public sanctions/PEP list entity as distributed to the Edge (EDGE_DATA_RESIDENCY_CONTRACT.md section 6.4). One JSON object per line inside a sanctions list chunk. Public data only: the entry id, the listed name and aliases exactly as the Control Plane ingested them into aml-microservice, the entity type and the PEP classification. The Edge normalises and scores these names with the aml-microservice algorithm (section 6.5).

name.description: Primary listed name (the source caption). May be empty when the source only lists aliases.

aliases.description: Other listed names, in source order, with blanks removed.

pepLevel.description: Present only for politically exposed persons (PEP) and their relatives / close associates (RCA). A PEP entry is never a sanctions hit (section 6.5).
